title: Auto Lock
features: Auto lock the base, not too hard.
script:
-- && Execute when base is unlocked! && --

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Rotations = 100

local function getRootPart()
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	return character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
end
local rootPart = getRootPart()

local function TPTOLock()
    if rootPart then
        local OGCF = rootPart.CFrame
    	rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(568, 1, -200)
        wait(0.5)
        rootPart.CFrame = OGCF
    end
end

repeat
    TPTOLock()
    wait(60.5)
until rotations == 0
